years: 2018-2022 previously studied, NOT untouched final test
calendar: SPY common US sessions; BTC weekends not traded
signal: after close t, rebalance at next SPY-session adjusted OPEN
mark: adjusted CLOSE on SPY session, with <=3-session backward stale marks for existing holdings
cash_rate: constant 0 daily unless explicitly supplied; not from a historical risk-free series
ml_forecast: uncalibrated, clipped +/-20% over 60d, blended 20% with 80% shrunken historical mean; sensitivity only
costs: EXACT transaction_fee_helper from transaction_fee_calculator branch: ETF half S04 full spread + 0.1*trade_usd^2/ADV_Dollars + IBKR fixed-share commissions; BTC IBKR volume-tiered commission only. Zero-cost scenario bypasses all fees.
cost_limits: ADV participation cap may leave stale holdings or cash; audit fills and target weight differences. Crypto monthly IBKR volume reset at each calendar-month start.
missing_s04_liquidity: An asset with unavailable decision-close spread/ADV is excluded from NEW investments; if already held, its shares are frozen and the remaining tradable holdings can rebalance using the residual risk budget, with frozen assets still counted in NAV. No missing fees are imputed. The objective for newly tradable assets does not model correlations with frozen holdings; this is an approximation. Events logged in rebalance_audit.csv.
mean_variance: calls original helper for modeled selected-asset trade fees in objective; exit costs of previously-held excluded assets independent of optimizer decision and included in actual fills
mean_cvar: includes linear marginal IBKR/share and spread proxy in LP; quadratic market impact and minimum commissions charged by original helper only at execution
other_allocators: risk targets without explicit modeled-cost penalties, all charged same realized execution costs
cvar: overlapping historical 60-session arithmetic return scenarios, not effective independent tail samples
limitations: Original fee helper assumes zero BTC spread/market impact; optimistic and not exchange-complete
Adj Open is adjusted ex post from Yahoo OHLCV
No intraday fills, cash borrow, leverage, shorting or funding accrual
Bitcoin 24/7 trading approximated on US exchange sessions
No ability to reconstruct stocks that did not exist in historical panel
Price-source data and user S04 cost data must be current
